title: Stage 4 confirmed should be judged by sustained output metrics, not score alone
summary: After the first confirmed Stage 4 baseline, the next control objective is sustained production. Track 24h and 72h windows for real artifact throughput, verified task throughput, cycle time, release output, recovery, and backlog replenishment, and treat blocked-to-done conversion as a ledger-backed metric rather than a snapshot inference.

real_artifact_throughput.definition: Count real artifacts whose latest evidence falls within the window.

verified_task_throughput.definition: Count verified completed tasks in the window.

median_task_cycle_time.definition: Median minutes from task creation to final completion/release.

release_output.definition: Released tasks and release readiness signals in the window.

self_recovery.definition: Auto-resolved messages as a share of total error-recovery events in the window.

backlog_replenishment.definition: Active goal count and ready-node count indicating the system can keep feeding work.

blocked_to_done_conversion.definition: Tasks that moved from blocked/failed states into completed/released states.

anti_gaming: Do not infer blocked-to-done conversion from snapshot-only task history.
Do not count a higher autonomy score as output quality unless it is accompanied by fresh real artifacts.
Do not treat release readiness as sufficient if artifact registry or reality dashboard regresses.
Use 24h and 72h bands together; 24h alone can hide churn.
